card.name: Dosage form after a number
card.fires_on: The dosage-form word (capsule, tablet, caps-ules) right after a count such as 1 or 3 in dosing instructions. Also a unit like g after a number.

modes.label: Form after count
modes.description: Capsule or tablet directly after a small number in a dose schedule.

modes.label: Split word capsules
modes.description: The ending of capsules after 'Caps' following a number.
